name: encoding-reflection-type-argument-decode
description: A type passed as a type argument to a generic declared outside the program, in a package whose own imports name a standard decoder, reaches a decoding destination, so the decoding method of the type a field of it holds is retained: through a generic function reached from a generic of the program, a generic method, a method of a generic type, and a type argument the call infers. A generic whose package imports no decoder, and one whose package imports a decoder only through another package, retain nothing, so those methods stay reported.
